stdout:
Created `docs/verification/phase_c_aural_exciter.md`. The document:

- Summarizes the Phase C Module B goal: sidechain HP (`EXC_TUNE` 800 Hz–10 kHz), three wave-shapers, 2x/4x oversampling, Air EQ shelf, and RT-safety constraints.
- Lists delivered files: `Source/DSP/AuralExciter.h` and `Source/DSP/AuralExciter.cpp` (inspected; symbols match the header/impl — `prepare`, `process`, `reset`, `JUCE_DECLARE_NON_COPYABLE_WITH_LEAK_DETECTOR`).
- Records the four verification commands verbatim (Ninja configure, Standalone build, `cppcheck --enable=all Source/DSP`, `clang-format --dry-run --Werror` on the two Aural Exciter sources) — no `make`.
- Explicit RT-safety notes: oversampler constructed and latency queried in `prepare()` only; `G`/`delta`/`gamma` smoothed via `SmoothedValue`; no locks/allocations on the audio thread.
- Provides a pass/fail table for each check (tools were unavailable in this environment, recorded honestly rather than self-evaluated).

No files outside `docs/verification/phase_c_aural_exciter.md` were created or modified; source code was not touched.
